reference.name: linear_baseline_dcan_v1
reference.note: The loop starts from this model (neuroasd/model.py), not from the old GCN PRs. A trial wins only if it beats these numbers under the rule below.

rule.note: PASS if either split's fold-mean balanced accuracy is at least 1pp above the reference and the other split drops by at most 0.5pp.

screen.rationale: Cheap filter on 6 mixed ABIDE I / II sites. The tangent baseline scores 0.677 here. 0.64 is above chance and below the reference, so class-weight and threshold trials are not killed by fold noise.

loso-site.rationale: Must stay near the linear site-LOSO reference (0.674) before paying for the institution sweep. 0.65 is a filter, not the destination.

loso-institution.rationale: Open a PR if site or institution balanced accuracy gains >= 0.01 vs linear_baseline_dcan_v1 and the other split drops by at most 0.005. Always report accuracy, AUC, ASD recall, and control recall so the number can be compared with the literature.
